model: System Management Sequencer (SMS) Option 275A for modular R-290 air-source heat pumps
aliases: modular R-290 air source heat pump
applies_to: Carrier's System Management Sequencer (option 275A), a control cabinet that stages up to four modular R-290 air-source heat pumps with zones, pumps, DHW and a back-up boiler.
summary: The SMS is a plant controller for up to four modular R-290 air-source heat pumps; it talks to the heat pumps over BACnet IP and offers BACnet IP and Modbus TCP to the BMS through the Ethernet switch in its cabinet. The object list has 315 objects grouped by function: general system commands and status, schedules, two heating/cooling zones, customer and DHW pump sets, the heat pump manager, and one block per heat pump.
notes: Source is the BACnet object spreadsheet (SMS_OPT275A_BACNET_COM) inside Carrier's "BMS Protocols" zip for option 275A; the zip's Modbus files are not used.
State texts are taken from the description cells (e.g. 1 = OFF / 2 = ON / 3 = Based on Schedule); long descriptions are shortened.
The heat pump n°1 to n°4 blocks are all printed in the sheet; blocks for heat pumps that are not installed stay unused.
Zone 2, DHW, boiler and pump-set points only apply when those parts of the plant are configured.
Integration notes also draw on the SMS IOM control manual (Carrier Europe document 10991, 12-2025).

source.title: SMS OPT275A BMS Protocols (BACnet object list SMS_OPT275A_BACNET_COM.xlsx)

integration.summary: Connect the BMS to the Ethernet switch in the SMS cabinet. Put the system in Auto operating type with the front button, then drive it with the On/Off input command (MV 502) and the heating/cooling selection (MV 521), adjust zone setpoints, and read system status, temperatures, heat pump status and the synthesis alarm.

minimum_points.name: manual_hc_sel_5
minimum_points.why: Heating/cooling selection (3 = auto changeover on OAT)

minimum_points.name: z1_setpoint_input_2
minimum_points.why: Zone 1 setpoint mode: Eco, Comfort or Auto

minimum_points.name: emergency_shutdown_5
minimum_points.why: Emergency shutdown signal from the BMS

minimum_points.name: ch1_status_1
minimum_points.why: Heat pump 1 status (running, failure, no comm...)

integration.enable: The system follows the On/Off input command only in the Auto operating type selected with the SMS front button (AV 501 reports it). In Auto the command can be Off, On or Based on Schedule. The network emergency stop shuts the system down in any operating type.
integration.remote_sensors: Zone relative humidity for dew point calculation (AV 264) can be written by the BMS when floor sensors are used.
setup: The SMS has five Ethernet ports for the heat pumps (BACnet IP) and the BMS (BACnet IP, Modbus TCP).
Each heat pump must be set to Network control mode, or the SMS raises a 'not in network mode' alarm and drops it from the sequence.
gotchas: Maintenance-mode BVs (e.g. BV 126-129) stop a heat pump or pump when set; do not leave them active.
Several points are labelled 'Zone n°1 or No Zone'; on a single-zone plant only the zone 1 points apply.
